overview.about: The John Deere Classic is a birdie-friendly PGA Tour stop at TPC Deere Run in Silvis, Illinois, played the week before The Open Championship. It has a reputation for giving young and first-time winners their breakthrough, and for flying its champion to the UK for the major.
overview.nextEvent: The next John Deere Classic is played at TPC Deere Run in the Quad Cities. Low, aggressive scoring is the norm on the receptive layout, with a charter jet on offer to reach The Open in time.
